module.name: CROWDAQ (v2)
module.author: CROWDAQ
module.description: Renders a live CROWDAQ single-game scoreboard on a Xibo display over the crowdaq.v1 WebSocket protocol (score, clock, last notable moment). Updates the score in place on each game event.

property.title: CROWDAQ WebSocket base URL
property.helpText: Base URL of the CROWDAQ game-delivery WebSocket (e.g. wss://game-delivery.tailnet or https://game-delivery.tailnet — http(s) is rewritten to ws(s)). The crowdaq.v1 /ws path is appended automatically. Multi-bar targeting: a value of the form display:<field> (e.g. display:displayName) is resolved at render time against the player's xiboIC.info() response so one layout serves many bars. Leave blank to render a "Configure wsBaseUrl" placeholder.

test.message: wsBaseUrl must be empty, a ws(s)://, an https?:// URL, or a display:<field> placeholder.

property.title: Bar ID override
property.helpText: Explicit CROWDAQ bar_id (UUID) for the DeviceRegistration handshake. Takes precedence over the player-reported hardwareKey. REQUIRED on the Xibo 4.0.x Linux player, whose xiboIC.info() endpoint 404s so the widget cannot self-discover the hardwareKey. Leave blank only on players that serve xiboIC.info().

property.title: Display ID override
property.helpText: Optional explicit display identifier surfaced in the DeviceRegistration handshake. Takes precedence over xiboIC.info().displayName. Defaults to the player-reported display name, else "unknown-display".

property.title: Player software version
property.helpText: Optional version string surfaced in the DeviceRegistration handshake. Defaults to "widget-v2".

property.title: Heartbeat interval (ms)
property.helpText: WebSocket heartbeat cadence. The crowdaq.v1 default is 30000 ms (30 s). Minimum 5000.

test.message: Heartbeat interval must be at least 5000 ms.
